from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInterestIncome(BaseModel):
    """Extracted interest income data from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period")
    interest_income_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of interest income reported")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., Yuan)")
    source_field: str | None = Field(description="The line item name where the value was found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    interest_income_records: list[CompanyInterestIncome]
